payload.title: detect_sql_enums keeps is_archived_migration_path as a guard no path can reach, because the registry glob's [0-9]* already excludes .archive/, so the archive rule has two owners: the live one an accident of the glob grammar and the documented one dead and blind to src/migrations/.archive/ in four services
evidence: tools/aria-poc/poc.py:969-979 (a path reaches the guard only after fullmatching a registry glob; the comment still presents the guard as the filter)
tools/aria-poc/poc.py:927-943 (_glob_pattern turns * into [^/]* and the glob needs a digit first, so a path under .archive/ cannot match)
tools/shared/excluded_paths.py:76-77 (the predicate needs /database/migrations/ and /.archive/, so src/migrations/.archive/ is not recognised)
apps/db-migrate/src/schema-registry.ts:170 (auth-service migrations live in src/migrations/ and the glob requires [0-9] first)
tools/aria-poc/invariants/test_poc.py:290-343 (the archived-migration test passes with the guard removed: only the glob excludes the file)
tools/aria-poc/invariants/test_poc_sql_enum_visibility.py:225-228 (the new test's own docstring says the predicate alone would not cover src/migrations/.archive/)
payload.rule_violated: Single owner per concept (CLAUDE.md Architectural Approach tier 2): one rule for 'is this a live migration', not a dead guard beside an accidental one
payload.notes: At this revision 55 tracked files sit under src/migrations/.archive/ (admin-api 22, auth 13, event-store 3, messaging 17), where the predicate returns False, and 105 under database/migrations/.archive/, where it would return True but the glob never lets them reach it. The archive exclusion therefore rests only on the reader's glob grammar (* never crosses a slash, ** is refused). A reader change that supports ** or deeper globs would let archived enums into the drift corpus while the documented guard looks present but is blind for four of the registered services. The enum corpus is identical with the guard replaced by lambda p: False (reviewer probe). Close condition: Delete the call and import in poc.py (and the predicate and its test if nothing else uses it), or make the predicate the registry glob's own consumer and cover src/migrations/.archive/; closed when a search for is_archived_migration_path shows no unreachable caller and test_archived_migrations_stay_out_in_every_registered_directory fails if the glob rule is relaxed. Plan row: DET detector program (landing batch 2b). Verified at head b2259fe03f of open pull request #2151; the cited code is not on main until that pull request merges.
